summary: Reproduced that unified deterministic extend attention used reciprocal xAI temperature scaling while regular extend/decode use logarithmic scaling. Aligned the unified formula and added both unified-vs-regular coverage and a deterministic same-kernel logarithmic reference covering positions below, at, and above the threshold.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before gfx950 regression against an independent logarithmic query-scaling reference. Per-position maximum output differences for absolute positions 3, 4, 5, and 6 with threshold 4 were [0.0, 0.37117624282836914, 0.3268224895000458, 0.9590050578117371].
Passing-after deterministic gfx950 kernel comparison to the independent logarithmic reference, including below-threshold position 3, threshold position 4, and above-threshold positions 5 and 6.
The corrected unified kernel passed the repository's existing AMD unified-vs-regular numerical tolerance with xAI scaling enabled.
Formatting tools could not run because the prepared interpreter does not contain the black or ruff modules; files were manually reviewed and git diff --check passed.

remaining_limitations: No Grok model weights or full serving/model accuracy run were used; validation is limited to focused Triton attention kernel execution and does not claim model semantic accuracy.

The complete registered unified-vs-regular matrix has an unrelated stochastic gfx950 tolerance failure in the pre-existing D=80, xai_temperature_len=-1 case (captured in raw/failing_before.log), so issue-specific validation used the isolated xAI case and the deterministic same-kernel reference.
black and ruff are absent from the prepared Python environment.
